title: Extra Fitting Fee Basis by the Garment's Needed-By Date — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Fee Table
content:
The extra fitting fee basis on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket takes exactly one of three forms, set by the ticket's needed-by date counted in calendar days from today.

| Ticket's needed-by date | Extra fitting fee basis |
|---|---|
| None recorded — open-ended fitting rounds | the class's extra fitting fee multiplied by the fitting's number among the extra fittings |
| Today, or 1 to 14 calendar days after today — a fitting that close to the date re-checks the whole job | the class's extra fitting fee plus 10 percent of the ticket's operation charges |
| More than 14 calendar days after today, or already passed | the class's extra fitting fee |

**Terms.** The fitting's number among the extra fittings is one more than the extra fitting fee charges already on the ticket: the first extra fitting is number 1, the next number 2. The ticket's operation charges are the total of the operation charges booked on it. The class's extra fitting fee is the extra fitting fee of the ticket's service class.

## Day count, both sides

| Needed-by date | Form |
|---|---|
| yesterday (already passed) | the class's extra fitting fee |
| today (day 0) | fee plus 10 percent of operation charges |
| 14 days after today | fee plus 10 percent of operation charges |
| 15 days after today | the class's extra fitting fee |

## Hypothetical cases (class fee taken as 20.00 USD, operation charges 180.00 USD)

| Ticket | Extra fitting fee charges already on it | Fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| no needed-by date | 1 (this is number 2) | 20.00 multiplied by 2, that is 40.00 USD |
| needed-by date in 10 days | 0 | 20.00 plus 18.00, that is 38.00 USD |
| needed-by date in 30 days | 2 | 20.00 USD |
| needed-by date passed last week | 0 | 20.00 USD |
